description:
From jump lines in bike parks to adrenaline-fueled race day trails, the Rossignol Super Heretic is built for full-throttle enduro riding. Its custom aluminum frame, four-bar linkage, and handpicked components combine agility, lightweight construction, and bulletproof durability to push your limits. Dial in your preferred geometry, play with the SRAM AXS drivetrain, and get ready to charge through the roughest descents and flowiest trails like never before. With 170mm of front travel and 165mm in the rear, it's ready for anything.

Agile, responsive enduro design
The hydroformed 6061 aluminum frame features a 165mm Horst-Link four-bar rear suspension platform for playful, confident descending.

Adaptive geometry
Choose attack mode or flow mode. The rear triangle's Flip Chip design lets you fine-tune the frame geometry to match the terrain and your riding style.

Lightweight and built to last
The Heretic frame is 20% lighter than previous generations, with a stiffer, more robust design. Oversized double-row bearings reduce maintenance and boost long-term reliability.

Supple, stiff, and enduro-ready
The Fox Factory 38 fork with 170mm of travel sets the benchmark for stiffness-to-weight ratio, with a ready-to-ride build designed for enduro and downhill. The Kashima coating ensures unmatched smoothness and longevity.
Paired with the RockShox Vivid Coil Ultimate rear shock, offering 165mm of ultra-sensitive, coil-sprung travel and a fully adjustable compression system, it delivers consistent, controlled absorption even on the gnarliest terrain.

Pro-level shifting precision and durability
The SRAM GX AXS 12-speed drivetrain is SRAM's bulletproof wireless system. Expect crisp, cable-free shifting and a direct-mount derailleur built for relentless reliability.

Race-grade braking power and control
Shimano's most powerful brake system delivers unmatched stopping power and modulation on the toughest terrain. Four-piston calipers and 200mm rotors provide pro-level braking performance and confidence.

Integrated storage
A hidden compartment in the downtube keeps essential tools secure and out of sight. Includes a multi-tool, tire lever, and bottle opener.
